thread:
Sam: Quick ping — PR 17421 is blocked in the merge queue. CI shows intermittent failures on the embed-index-integ test in shard-7 (linux). Happened 3x in the last hour.
Alex: Ugh. I saw that failure earlier, it's a timeout in `embed_index_writer::flush()` — stack looks like IO stall.
Morgan: Can someone grab logs from shard-7? I can bisect if we get a consistent repro.
CI Bot: buildkite: PR-17421 | shard-7 failed: `embed-index-integ` (timeout). Logs uploaded: https://redwood.ci/builds/17421/7 :warning:
Sam: I pulled the logs — looks like this stacktrace: ```
ERROR: timed out waiting for write
at src/storage/kv/async_writer.rs:212
thread 'tokio-runtime-worker' panicked at 'index flush timeout'
```
Jamie: @Morgan FYI I pushed a tiny commit to reduce concurrency yesterday — maybe that regresses on certain kernels.
Morgan: OK will try a targeted rerun on shard-7 first. If it flakes again I'll run a bisect. /rerun ci shard=7 :runner:
Alex: If rerun fails, can we try `SKIP_LONG_IO=1` env to see if it's related to the heavy IO path? Also capture perf counters.
Priya: I can provision a debug instance with the same kernel and reproduce locally, ping me when you have a failing build id.
CI Bot: buildkite: PR-17421 | shard-7 rerun started by @Morgan (build 17421.7.r1)
Morgan: Rerun finished — passed once, failed on second try (same timeout). I'm starting a bisect with binary search across the last 6 commits.
Sam: Thanks. Important we don't hold the merge window too long — can we do a canary merge to a feature branch and run extended flakes there?
Alex: Good call. I'll open a short-lived branch `canary/17421-flake` and push a candidate to exercise the embed flush path repeatedly.
Jamie: Leaving :eyes: on the canary. If we see correlation with my concurrency change I'll revert and ship a follow-up.
Priya: Once you have the failing build id, post it here and I'll ssh into the debug VM to run the `strace` and `iostat` checks.
Sam: Plan summary: 1) Morgan bisect, 2) Alex create canary + stress runs, 3) Priya debug VM on failing build, 4) flip SKIP_LONG_IO on CI if needed. If we confirm regression we'll roll back Jamie's change and request a hotfix. :thumbsup:
Morgan: Starting bisect now, will update with the culprit commit or when we need extra hands.
Alex: Thanks all — also adding this to the PR description so reviewers know why it's blocked.
Sam: Appreciate it. If anyone sees a quick fix for the timeout condition in `async_writer`, drop a draft PR and tag me for fast review. :rocket:
